full_details.title: Assist with UK Business Identity Verification
full_details.full_description:
I need a reliable pair of hands to jump onto Companies House with me and get my company’s identity verification completed. The account is already set up; what’s holding me back is the identity check Companies House now asks for before I can update my details. I will provide secure, time-limited login access and the necessary personal documents. Your role is to navigate the WebFiling/Verify screens, upload the documents, confirm the required selfie-match step, and finish the update so the system shows my information as verified.

Once the verification is accepted, I also want to change a couple of minor data points in the company record—nothing complex, just straightforward “Update information” clicks so the public profile is current.

Deliverable: a quick call or chat while you complete the steps, followed by a confirmation screenshot (or PDF receipt) from Companies House showing the green tick for identity and the revised company details.

Familiarity with Companies House processes and UK KYC requirements will make this a painless twenty-minute job, and I’m ready to start as soon as you are.
